titulo: 国家自然科学基金委员会医学科学部青年科学基金项目（A类）（原国家杰出青年科学基金项目）注意事项补充说明 03-12
descricao: no video 国家自然科学基金委员会遵循医学科学属性和临床医学人才成长规律，自2024年起在青年科学基金项目（A类）申请中增加“临床科学”附注说明选项，并组织开展分类评审，鼓励青年临床医师立足临床实践，以揭示疾病本质、改善临床结局为研究目标，开展创新性科学研究和技术探索。 申报青年科学基金项目（A类）并在附注说明中选择“临床科学”选项的申请人，务必上传下述电子版文件。 1.国家医师资格证书和执业证书（电子文件内需包含证书全部内容页）； 2.卫生系列高级专业技术职称资格证书或证明（所在省市或单位统一不发放职称资格证书的申请人，请提供相关证明）； 3.所在医疗机构出具的卫生系列高级专业技术职称聘任证书或证明（应为职称聘任证书、聘任公文，或所在医疗机构加盖法人公章或人事部门章的职称聘任证明，并注明起聘时间）。 特别提醒：以上职称资格证书、职称聘任证书或证明均应为主任医师、副主任医师等卫生系列高级专业技术职称；仅提供教学、科研系列职称证明如教授、研究员等，或仅提供行政职务聘任证明，如科室副主任等，将视为未按要求提供相关证明材料。 链接：2024年医学科学部国家杰出青年科学基金项目申请注意事项 国家自然科学基金委员会遵循医学科学属性和临床医学人才成长规律，自2024年起在青年科学基金项目（A类）申请中增加“临床科学”附注说明选项，并组织开展分类评审，鼓励青年临床医师立足临床实践，以揭示疾病本质、改善临床结局为研究目标，开展创新性科学研究和技术探索。 申报青年科学基金项目（A类）并在附注说明中选择“临床科学”选项的申请人，务必上传下述电子版文件。 1.国家医师资格证书和执业证书（电子文件内需包含证书全部内容页）； 2.卫生系列高级专业技术职称资格证书或证明（所在省市或单位统一不发放职称资格证书的申请人，请提供相关证明）； 3.所在医疗机构出具的卫生系列高级专业技术职称聘任证书或证明（应为职称聘任证书、聘任公文，或所在医疗机构加盖法人公章或人事部门章的职称聘任证明，并注明起聘时间）。 特别提醒：以上职称资格证书、职称聘任证书或证明均应为主任医师、副主任医师等卫生系列高级专业技术职称；仅提供教学、科研系列职称证明如教授、研究员等，或仅提供行政职务聘任证明，如科室副主任等，将视为未按要求提供相关证明材料。 链接：2024年医学科学部国家杰出青年科学基金项目申请注意事项

extras.titulo_original: 国家自然科学基金委员会中德科学中心2026年度中德学生与青年学者短期讲习班项目指南 04-29
extras.descricao_original: 根据国家自然科学基金委员会（NSFC）与德国研究联合会（DFG）达成的协议，并经中德科学中心（SGC）联委会批准，中德科学中心2026年将资助“中德学生与青年学者短期讲习班”项目。 一、项目说明 （一）资助领域 数理科学、化学科学、生命科学、地球科学、工程与材料科学、信息科学、管理科学和医学科学。 （二）项目执行期 项目执行期自项目获批日起至2027年12月31日截止。总时长不超过14天。 （三）资助内容 为针对特定研究领域内基础性或专题性问题开展的培训、研讨等活动提供资助。资助费用包括学员及教师的国内和国际旅费、食宿费用、会议场地费等。具体资助标准请参见中德学生与青年学者短期讲习班资助标准（附件4）。 （四）人员构成及学员选拔要求 1. 学员构成应体现中德合作特色，其中访问国学员占比原则上不低于学员总人数的30%，不超过50%。 2. 学员总数原则上不超过50人。根据参训学员学历层次，项目分为两类：1）. 参训学员为中德两国青年科研人员（在读博士研究生、在站博士后研究人员）；2）. 参训学员为中德两国本科学生。 3. 学员遴选须注意男女比例均衡。 4. 学员选拔须采用公开、竞争性遴选方式，申请材料中须包含详细的遴选机制说明。 5. 中德双方申请人须共同担任讲习班教师，并可邀请最多4名资深科学家参与授课。 二、申请人条件 （一）中方申请人需满足以下条件： 1. 正在承担或承担过3年期（含）以上国家自然科学基金资助项目的项目负责人； 2. 正在承担或承担过3年期（含）以上国家自然科学基金资助项目的主要参与者且具有高级专业技术职务（职称）或博士学位或有2名与其研究领域相同、具有高级专业技术职务（职称）的科学技术人员推荐，并应当经国家自然科学基金资助项目负责人同意。 请注意，正在承担或承担过的国家自然科学基金资助项目不包括国际（地区）合作交流项目。 （二）德方申请人应具有博士学位，且具有申请DFG项目的资格。 三、限项规定 （一）本项目不计入国家自然科学基金限项范围。 （二）申请人同年限申请一项本项目。 四、申报说明 （一）申请书要求 项目应围绕特定研究领域中的基础性或专题性问题，组织培训或研讨活动。项目申请书（附件1）须以英文撰写，具体要求请见中德讲习班项目申请书填写说明（附件2）。申请书内容须包括： 1. 项目主题与科学意义； 2. 详细组织方案与日程安排； 3. 学员选拔流程与标准； 4. 申请人及教师学术简历； 5. 基于组织方案及日程安排编制的项目预算。 （二）数据安全要求 鉴于项目的国际合作属性，研究数据的跨境传输应符合中德两国及欧盟有关数据安全、隐私保护和知识产权等法律法规要求。合作过程中所使用的所有数据必须可公开获取。中德双方申请人应确保合作所涉及数据不违反两国相关法律，并提交本人签字的《知情同意书》（附件3），承诺遵守中德双方关于个人数据保护的相关法律法规。 （三）提交要求 须提交电子版申请书（含Word文档及签字扫描PDF格式文档）及知情同意书。申请材料须发送至：Workshop2026@sinogermanscience.org.cn。邮件主题须注明“2026年中德学生与青年学者短期讲习班申请（申请人姓名）”。电子版全部申请材料文件总大小不得超过15MB。申请书PDF格式文档首页须加盖中方依托单位公章。 （四）申报时限 申报截止时间为北京时间2026年5月31日16时，以中德科学中心邮箱接收到申请邮件的时间为准，逾期不予受理。申请书一经提交，原则上不允许撤回修改。 （五）依托单位注意事项 依托单位应对本单位申请人所提交申请材料的真实性、完整性和合规性，申报预算的目标相关性、政策相符性和经济合理性进行审核，并加强对科研诚信、科技伦理和研究数据跨境传输合规性的审核。 五、联系方式 中方联系人：闫老师 办公电话：+86-10-82361301 电子邮箱：Workshop2026@sinogermanscience.org.cn 英文指南链接：https://www.dfg.de/de/aktuelles/neuigkeiten-themen/info-wissenschaft/2026/ifw-26-27 国家自然科学基金委员会中德科学中心2026年4月29 日 extras.descricao_original: News NSFC Headlines News Updates Policy NSFC Constitution NSFC Regulations Report NSFC Annual Report International Cooperation Introduction Partnerships Categories The Research Fund For International Scientists Science Fund for Global Challenges and Sustainability Funding & Support Application and Review Process Guide to Programs In general, funding opportunities are announced both in the NSFC Guide to Programs and through Call for Proposals (CFP) on the NSFC website. Usually any CFP should be announced at least one month ahead of the start date of the submission period. 2- Application Submission In response to the CFP, applicants submit applications first to their host institutions for approval via the NSFC ISISN system. Then the host institutions will be responsible for approving and submitting the applications to the NSFC. Once the applications are received by NSFC, eligibility checks will be carried out in accordance with relevant qualification requirements of different programs. The results of eligibility checks will be notified to the applicants, specifying whether the applications are accepted for review or rejected without review. If the applicant disagrees with a rejection, he or she is allowed to submit a complaint or request for eligibility recheck. NSFC needs to handle such requests within 60 days and reserves the right to carry out the eligibility recheck or reject the request in line with related regulations. NSFC adopts a two-step review mechanism for the majority of proposals received, which consists of mail review and panel review. For mail review, each application will be assigned to at least three reviewers in related scientific filed from the expert database. Based on the results and comments of mail review, the applications will be ranked by the NSFC. Applications will be further assessed by panel review at which a shortlist of applications will be recommended for funding. The final funding decision will be made by NSFC based on the panel recommendations. The funding decision will be notified to the applicants and the review comments of each application will be provided to the applicants as well. If the applicant disagrees with the funding decision, he or she is allowed to submit a complaint or request for secondary review. NSFC needs to handle such requests within 60 days and reserves the right to carry out the secondary review or reject the request in line with related regulations. Add: 83 Shuangqinglu Rd., Haidian District, Beijing, China

descricao: Fiscal Year 2025Guide to Programs National Natural Science Foundation of China Fiscal Year 2025 Guide to Programs Fiscal Year 2025 Guide to Programs National Natural Science Fund Guide to Programs 2025 National Natural Science Foundation of China Brief Introduction The National Natural Science Foundation of China publishes the National Natural Science Fund Guide to Programs 2024 (the Guide) , in accordance with the National Natural Science Foundation Regulations and relevant documents on program management, to provide applicants with useful guidance on seeking support from the National Natural Science Fund. The Guide details NSFC’s latest reform measures, application requirements, funding policies and funding priorities, and introduces different program types and their respective requirements. It is an important basis for the allocation of the National Natural Science Fund, and also a must -read reference for applicants. This book can be used as a reference for researchers in universities and colleges of higher education and research institutions, and for people working in areas of S&T management and policy research. Editorial Committee Chairperson DOU Xiankang Executive Chairperson WANG Xiqin Vice Chairperson WANG Yan Members (in alphabetical order) FENG Wen’an FU Xuefeng HONG Wei LI Dong LIU Ke LIU Zuoyi LYU Qunyan NI Peigen PENG Jie WANG Kun WANG Qidong YANG Junlin YANG Liexun YAO Yupeng YIN Wenxuan ZHANG Fengzhu ZHANG Yongtao Editors (in alphabetical order) HAO Hongquan SUN Chaoli WANG Chunjiao YANG Haohao ZHENG Zhimin Foreword The Third Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee drew a blueprint for further comprehensively deepening reform, opened a new chapter in promoting Chinese-style modernization in the new era, and made systematic arrangements for building a system and mechanism to support comprehensive innovation. President Xi Jinping highlighted at the National Science and Technology Conference that one of the essential elements of building an S&T power is to “have strong basic research and original innovation capabilities, and continuously produce major original and disruptive scientific and technological achievements" and encouraged us work hard, and step by step to turn the strategic goal of building an S&T power into reality1. In the year of 2025, under the guidance of Xi Jinping’s Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, the National Natural Science Foundation of China (hereinafter referred to as NSFC) will comprehensively implement the spirits of the 20 th CPC National Congress and its Second and Third Plenary Sessions, thoroughly implement President Xi’s important speech on science, technology and innovation, especially on basic research and the spirits of the National S&T Conference. In accordance with the decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, under the leadership of the Science and Technology Commission of the CPC Central Committee, NSFC will firmly grasp the strategic positioning in the new era, adhere to the "four aspects", earnestly implement the newly revised Regulations on the National Natural Science Foundation, coordinate the deployment of basic research, applied basic research and personnel training, and strengthen support for original innovation and disruptive scientific and technological innovation. NSFC will strengthen the forward -looking, strategic and systematic layout of basic research, continue to improve the effectiveness of science funding, better leverage the unique role of science fund in the national innovation system, and strongly support the realization of self-reliance in high-level science and technology. NSFC will strengthen the basic research system layout and strengthen China’s original innovation capability. The key to enhancing China's original innovation ability is to strengthen basic research, establish a scientific and i 1Xi Jinping. Speech at the National S&T Conference, National S&T Award Conference and Aca- demicians Conference. June 24, 2024. https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202406/content_6959 120.htm. technological innovation system that is original innovation -oriented and an efficient and coordinated scientific research organization model, and change from the defense of “reinforcing weak boards” to the competition of “building long boards”. It is necessary to encourage free exploration, maintain the overall stability of the proportion of funding for self -selected topics, and stabilize the “bedrock” of funding for basic research. NSFC will continue to optimize the layout of disciplines and promote interdisciplinary integration and research. NSFC will highlight originality, establish and improve the evaluation mechanism to support original research, explore to establish the funding mechanism for non -consensual proposals for major types of programs, and select and fund original and disruptive research with innovative, controversial and high-risk characteristics. NSFC will improve the basic conditions for scientific research and support the systematic development of scientific instruments and means. NSFC will build a systematic platform for cultivating talents for basic research, and cultivate high -level talents for scientific and technological innovation. The key to high -level basic research is talent, with an emphasis on distributing limited state funding to support China's most dynamic front -line scientists. It is necessary to continue to carry out the pilot program of subsidizing outstanding undergraduate students and doctoral students, strengthen the training of reserve forces for basic research, and provide a “source of fresh water” for building a pool of high - level basic research talents. NSFC will increase support for young researchers and actively attract outstanding young talents to participate in peer review. NSFC will continue the evaluation and continued funding for the concluded projects of the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars, and strengthen the training of high -level scientific and technological talents. NSFC will strengthen support for young talents in the Science Fund for Creative Research Groups and Science Fund for Excellent Research Groups, and strive to build a highly innovative talent echelon. NSFC will strengthen the management of funding for applied basic research, and improve the capability of basic research to support national strategic goals. Summarizing the major research needs in basic, cutting-edge and cross-cutting fields is an important responsibility and task of NSFC to implement the deployment of central science and technology work and excel in applied basic research in the new era. It is necessary to fulfill the responsibilities of the main responsible units, continue to do a good job in the preparation of annual guidelines for National Key Research and Development Plans, and organize the implementation of major national science and technology projects of “brain science and brain -like research”. We will strengthen the role of NSFC’s Advisory Committee, put forward high -quality proposals for selecting major national science and technology projects in the field of basic research for the 15th Five-Year Plan, and carry out high-standard research on the development strategy National Natural Science Fund Guide to Programs 2024 ii of science funds and the formulation of plans. NSFC will continue to strengthen the overall coordination of major types of NSFC programs and national science and technology major programs, clearly define their positioning, systematically plan the deployment of science fund guidelines and guidance projects, and form a reasonably structured and efficient collaborative project system. NSFC will continue to improve the mechanism for diversified investment in basic research, steadily expand the scope of joint fund cooperation, optimize cooperation models, strengthen guidance, make better use of the leverage of central fiscal investment, and improve the funding performance of the Joint Funds. NSFC will enhance the management of scientific research integrity and academic ethics, and cultivate a healthy and positive scientific research environment. The fair evaluation of NSFC projects is related to whether outstanding talents can get timely and effective support, the overall development of the national scientific research cause, and the actual results of the construction of a S&T power and a talents power. NSFC will work with the discipline inspection and supervision team of the Ministry of Science and Technology to further strengthen the supervision and restriction of the whole process of project review, and consolidate and expand the special rectification work results of “string -pulling”. NSFC will thoroughly implement the action plan to improve the academic ethics of its funds through education, encouragement, standardization, supervision, and punishment systems, promote the construction of science and technology ethics in its funds in an orderly manner, strengthen publicity and education on the integrity of scientific research, seriously investigate and punish cases of misconduct in scientific research, and guide researchers to seek truth and carry out responsible scientific research. NSFC will explore to establish a reputation evaluation mechanism for host institutions, improve the main responsibility awareness and management service level of host institutions, and effectively reduce the burden and relieve the constraints of researchers, ensuring that researchers are fully engaged in research work. NSFC will promote international exchanges and cooperation in basic research and support the building of an open innovation ecosystem with global competitiveness. Scientific and technological progress is a worldwide and contemporary issue, and basic research is an important bridge to promote international scientific and technological cooperation. It is necessary to give full play to the institutional advantages of the internationally accepted academic rules and operating mechanisms of NSFC, and further strengthen the opening -up. NSFC will improve the operation and management mechanism of the Department of International Programs, expand and deepen international joint research, support global talents to conduct basic research in China, and deeply integrate into the global scientific and technological innovation network. NSFC will expand and deepen inter -organizational strategic iii Foreword partnerships, strengthen dialogue, exchange and joint funding with overseas research funding institutions, international organizations and the scientific community, and foster an open, trusting and cooperative research environment. NSFC will continue to promote the development of the Sustainable Development International Cooperation Program, deeply participate in international negotiations on climate change, and continue to promote bilateral and multilateral cooperation on climate change.
